headline: Cisco shares slide 9% despite earnings beat
detail: This indicates that even positive earnings can lead to sell-offs if market sentiment shifts or guidance isn't strong enough. It's a reminder that stock performance isn't solely tied to reported numbers.

headline: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report
detail: This highlights the risk in newer tech IPOs, especially after their initial post-IPO excitement fades. Leveraged positions in similar names could be vulnerable to sharp drops.
rec: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL given their leveraged nature and current SELL status, mirroring the risk shown by Cerebras.
